edges.reason: Constructor writes initial owner into _owner.
Constructor credits full _tTotal to the deployer balance.
msg.sender becomes the privileged initial owner during construction.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the transfer.
transferFrom derives allowance spend authority from _msgSender().
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
setFeeTotal uses _msgSender() for the zero-address check and mints to it.
transfer delegates all state changes to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates all state changes to _transfer.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
_transfer subtracts from sender and adds to recipient balances via SafeMath.
_transfer compares recipient against privileged _tBotAddress.
_transfer compares sender against privileged _tBlackAddress.
_transfer enforces transfer cap using _maxBlack.
setFeeTotal is the only path that increases _tTotal.
setFeeTotal credits newly minted tokens to the owner balance.
setFeeTotal enables unrestricted owner-only minting of new supply.
Approve(address) lets the owner set the _tBotAddress backdoor target.
setBlackAddress lets the owner set the fee-exempt _tBlackAddress.
Approve(uint256) rescales _maxBlack by multiplying with 10**18.
transferOwnership rewrites the privileged _owner slot.
renounceOwnership emits the transfer but leaves _owner unchanged.
owner() ignores _owner and returns address(0), misleading integrators.
sendValue hands control to recipient via low-level call with value.
_functionCallWithValue forwards control and value to an untrusted target.
transferFrom reduces the caller allowance in _allowances via SafeMath.sub.

normalization_plan.reason: sender is only consumed by _transfer and should be folded into the transfer logic node.
recipient only affects _transfer balance and blacklist checks.
amount is the arithmetic input to _transfer SafeMath operations.
owner is only used to index _allowances inside _approve.
spender is only used to index _allowances inside _approve.
newOwner is solely written into _owner by transferOwnership.
amount is the mint quantity driving the unsafe supply inflation.
maxTxBlackPercent is scaled into _maxBlack by the setter.
msgSender local is only used to seed _owner and mint initial supply in the constructor.
